entities.name: LIMITED-SERVICE state
entities.description: A UE state where only limited services are available, including cell selection/reselection, paging response with IMSI, and emergency services.

entities.name: Cell selection/reselection
entities.description: UE performs cell selection and reselection according to 3GPP TS 36.304.

entities.name: Paging response with IMSI
entities.description: UE may respond to paging using IMSI, with MUSIM UE implementation option to not respond based on paging message information.

entities.name: Emergency attach procedure
entities.description: UE may detach locally and initiate attach for emergency bearer services or access to RLOS.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: UE configured for eCall only mode performs eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445.

entities.name: Timer T3444
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: Timer T3445
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: eCall only mode configured
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

relations.description: In LIMITED-SERVICE state, UE shall perform cell selection/reselection.
In LIMITED-SERVICE state, UE may respond to paging with IMSI.
In LIMITED-SERVICE state, UE may detach locally and initiate attach for emergency services.
If UE is configured for eCall only mode, it shall perform eCall inactivity procedure at timer expiry.
Expiry of timer T3444 triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3445 triggers eCall inactivity procedure.
